svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Reviewer failure path
svg.desc: How a reviewer's failure becomes a named category, a red job with an artifact, and a posted verdict that is never an approval.
